principle: Color/photo/logo/copy swaps alone never count as meaningful uniqueness.
calibration_procedure: Blind reviewers to brand identity where practical; judge structure before tokens.
Use controlled skin-swap pairs as positive resemblance anchors: if only brand/color/photo/copy changed, premium uniqueness must fail.
Use same-family distinct pairs to protect Creative Family reuse from false-positive template failure.
Use different-family pairs as negative anchors for screenshot gestalt and decision-grammar separation.
Prioritize multimodal human-perception judgment of screenshot gestalt, hero silhouette, repeated module sequence, grid, media framing and rhythm over naive color distance.
Do not set a numeric hard threshold from these 24 pairs. Add real generated-output pairs and inter-reviewer agreement data before threshold calibration.
